Subject: PO 4521 and onboarding: routing / VAT / payment rails

Hi Irene,

Attached is PO 4521 for the upcoming integration work (PDF attached: SpectraWorks_PO_4521.pdf). AP asked we confirm a few items before we create the vendor record in our portal:

- Do you have a preferred payment rail? (SEPA credit transfer vs. SWIFT).
- For EU VAT: are you invoicing net with reverse-charge or zero-rated? We need the supplier VAT ID and any self-certification.
- Will Redwood issue one consolidated invoice per PO or multiple invoices per milestone?

We need vendor registration completed by 09/10 to hit the first payment cycle. Can you confirm who on your side owns onboarding (bank details + tax evidence)?

Appreciate a quick reply — copying our AP team.

Thanks,
Sven Mueller
Head of Procurement — SpectraWorks GmbH
Sven.Mueller@spectraworks.de

Subject: Re: PO 4521 and onboarding: routing / VAT / payment rails

Hi Sven — thanks for the PO and the heads-up. Quick answers below and next steps.

- Preferred rails: We can accept SEPA (EUR) or SWIFT (USD). For SEPA please provide IBAN; for SWIFT we will provide bank + intermediary bank details.
- VAT handling: Redwood will invoice net with reverse-charge for EU B2B where valid VAT IDs are provided. Attached is a quick VAT self-cert we can return (Redwood_VAT_self-cert.pdf) — I can complete and upload to your portal.
- Invoicing cadence: We prefer one invoice per PO when possible (single invoice tied to PO 4521). If you need milestone invoices we can accommodate — confirm preferred invoice reference scheme.

Looping in Marissa (finance) to share Redwood's vendor record package and Karthik to coordinate the portal registration.

Best,
Irene Choi
Procurement Ops — Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Redwood_VAT_self-cert.pdf

Hi Sven — Marissa here (Finance). Thanks for the PO. A couple of clarifications so our teams can complete vendor provisioning: 

1) Bank / currency: If payment will be in EUR via SEPA, please set the payment currency to EUR on the PO. We will supply an IBAN once the vendor record is created. For cross-currency USD payments we will provide SWIFT + beneficiary details and indicate any bank fees.

2) Invoice format & reference: Please confirm you want the invoice header to include PO 4521 and the Redwood vendor code once created. Our preferred invoice reference is: Redwood-VendorCode_PO-4521. If you need line-level PO matching we can include invoice lines with PO line refs.

3) VAT / reverse-charge: We can accept reverse-charge only if you capture our EU VAT number during vendor creation. If you require us to invoice VAT, note that Redwood's legal billing entity for this contract is Redwood Inference Ltd. (VAT ID: EU123456789). We will not apply VAT on B2B EU sales with a valid purchaser VAT number.

4) Remit-to and cutoffs: AP cutoff for the next cycle is 09/15. To make that cycle, vendor registration (including bank validation) needs to be complete by EOD 09/10.

Irene attached our VAT self-cert; Karthik — can you confirm who will own the upload in SpectraWorks' portal and whether Redwood should register directly or you prefer SpectraWorks to invite?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Finance Ops — Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick replies. A few items from AP and the onboarding desk:

1) Portal invite: We have sent an invite to vendor-portal@redwoodinference.com — please accept and complete the vendor profile (link below). Invite expires 7 days after receipt.

2) VAT handling: We accept reverse-charge for non-German EU suppliers who provide a valid VAT number. Please upload Redwood Inference Ltd.'s VAT certificate and complete the EU VAT field in the vendor profile.

3) Payment rails: SEPA is preferred (EUR). If you provide IBAN we will set payment method to SEPA and include the PO reference. For SWIFT (USD) payments we require beneficiary name + account + bank address. Bank validation can take up to 48 hours.

4) Invoice sample: Attached is our preferred invoice template (SW_Invoice_4521-1.pdf). Please ensure PO 4521 appears in the invoice header and that amounts are clearly stated in EUR if paying via SEPA.

5) Cutoff: To hit the 09/15 cycle we need completed vendor setup by EOD 09/10.
